messages:
maria_sec: Report received from PentestCo (ref PTC-220). They dropped the report + PoCs into S3 link. Scope includes: KMS metadata, console RBAC, and audit ingestion. Need owners + retest window.

 dave_sre: Upload link? I'll start pulling logs for repro. Also need the vendor test IPs so we can whitelist ephemeral roles.

 maria_sec: Link: https://s3.aws.internal/pt-reports/PTC-220. Vendor asked for metadata access to keys only. Not allowing crypto ops.

 liz_pm: Timeline question: how quickly can we validate and schedule a retest? Typical customer-facing SLA expectations?

 maria_sec: Suggest baseline: retest within 10 business days after we confirm fixes and evidence. If >=3 critical findings, extend to 15 business days.

 ankur_eng: For vendor access we should use short-lived `sso-proxy` roles (max 6h). No long-lived cloudadm or full-admin. I'll add an approval step in JIRA.

 jon_ops: Ops OK with ephemeral. Will add automation to create role, rotate creds at end of window, and revoke. Need at least 48h notice to snap infra state.

 dave_sre: On logs: we need KMS key access logs exported to s3://compliance/kms-pt/PTC-220/ and set 180d retention. Also route debug-level events to a separate SIEM index for the test window only.

 maria_sec: Adding checklist draft — react :white_check_mark: when good: 
- create ephemeral vendor role via sso-proxy (6h)
- attach `vendor-kms-metadata-only` policy (deny decrypt/generate)
- whitelist vendor IPs for test window
- create evidence bucket with `sec-only` ACL and lifecycle 365d
- enable debug audit for kms-prod-* during window and export to compliance path
- require PoC reproducible steps from vendor before scheduling retest

 ankur_eng: IAM policy sketch (will put in repo):

```
{
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:DescribeKey","kms:GetKeyRotationStatus","kms:ListAliases"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/*"},
    {"Effect":"Deny","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/*"}
  ]
}
```

 dave_sre: Confirming: we will not provide `kms:Decrypt` during the test unless a special approval is raised and logged.

 jon_ops: For ingestion cost concerns — debug logs only for the exact scheduled window (start/end timestamps). We'll spin them into `siem-ptc220` and cap ingestion.

 liz_pm: Who will run triage board and mark severity/priority? We need one owner to avoid confusion.

 maria_sec: Security will own intake + triage. Eng owns remediation tickets. Product will own customer comms if needed.

 ankur_eng: I'll create a JIRA epic PT-220 and link todos. Assign approvers: infra approval = dave_sre, security sign-off = maria_sec.

 dave_sre: I'll own infra approvals. Also request vendor provide exact repro commands or curl/CLI steps for each finding. No retest without reproducible PoC.

 maria_sec: Agreed. Update checklist: "Require PoC steps + test account mapping from vendor".

 jon_ops: Canary/rollback plan for infra changes: snapshot AMI/state -> deploy to 10% canary -> monitor 1h -> promote or rollback. Documented in ops runbooks. Tag #eng-oncall when scheduling.

 ankur_eng: For RBAC changes, recommend a 2-approver flow: one infra reviewer, one security reviewer. Keeps mistakes down.

 liz_pm: Sounds good. Also prepare a customer-facing template in case any external customers are impacted. I'll draft and post to #product.

 securitybot: Reminder: All remediation artifacts must be uploaded to the evidence bucket and ACL set to `sec-only`.

 maria_sec: Next actions list:
- @ankur_eng: create JIRA epic PT-220 + vuln tickets and link vendor PoCs
- @jon_ops: automation for ephemeral role + evidence bucket policy (PR)
- @dave_sre: export KMS logs -> s3://compliance/kms-pt/PTC-220/ with 180d retention; prepare SIEM index
- @liz_pm: draft comms template if needed

 ankur_eng: Will create epic and initial tickets by EOD. Will include approver fields.

 jon_ops: Automation PR ETA: 36h. Will include revoke job.

 dave_sre: Logs export and SIEM index ready in 72h.

 liz_pm: Draft comms by EOD, will ping #product for review.

 maria_sec: Vendor contact is alice@pentestco.com. I'll DM vendor for IP list and test accounts. Once we have IPs, ops will whitelist for the window.

 ankur_eng: One more — do we want to allow metadata-only `DescribeKey` across all keys or limit to in-scope ARNs? Prefer limit to scope.

 maria_sec: Limit to scoped ARNs. Add that to policy.

 maria_sec: Closing thread for now. Will reopen when vendor responds with IPs and test account list. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
